candidates.passage: Petra opened the clock shop before dawn. She always reached for the fine tweezers before the flat pliers. The loupe stood on the mat by the door. A tray of springs lay beside it. She kept well away from the sticky oil. Every morning for nine years she had dusted the loupe first.
candidates.question: A free hour comes up next week. Going only by the passage, which of these does Petra do first?
candidates.right: reaching for the fine tweezers again
wrong: reaching for the flat pliers again
moving the loupe to the yard
hanging the springs on a hook

candidates.question: A visitor asks for help later that day. Going only by the passage, which of these does Petra leave to someone else?
